बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम गरमा-गरम और बड़ी अपडेट! 🔥
रणबीर कपूर और यश स्टारर मचअवेटेड फिल्म Ramayana Part One ने रिलीज से पूरे दस दिन पहले ही बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है। 🎬
फिल्म ने नेशनल चेन में दो लाख टिकटों की भारी-भरकम एडवांस बुकिंग दर्ज कर ली है। 🎟️
साथ ही यश ने फैंस से अपील की है कि वे Ranbir Kapoor स्टारर इस फिल्म की छोटी-मोटी गलतियों को नजरअंदाज करें और साथ मिलकर दुनिया को दिखाएं। 🤝
क्या आपने भी अपनी टिकट बुक कर ली है या फिर इंतजार कर रहे हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में जल्दी से बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Part One Advance Booking Update: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash starrer sold 2 lakh tickets at national chains 10 days before release
ctx.summary:
We are ten days out from the release of Ramayana: Part One. The film went on sale a couple of days ago, and since then it has kept the cash counter ringing. At EOD today, the film will have over 175,000 ticket sales at the two national chains, including 90,000 for the first day. The aforementioned numbers are for the Hindi version only; add to that the sales for the Kannada and Telugu versions, and this figure rises to nearly 200,000. 
 Other than national chains, the film has sales open in other chains as well and some single screens in South India for dubbed versions. In all, the advances for Hindi versions for the weekend are over Rs. 10 crore nett. 
 Indian films generally don’t open sales this far out; Ramayana is an exception to that. The one comparable film is Dhurandhar: The Revenge, which opened 11 days out but just for previews. At the same time before release, i.e. in the first two days of sales, Dhurandhar: The Revenge had sold 135,000 tickets. This isn’t an apples-to-apples comparison either, but the closest one we got. 
 In presales, what matters most is the performance during the final stretch, starting from Monday before release to the day before release. The day before release at times could change the entire outlook of advance. For now, Ramayana: Part One has a healthy head start, which it continues to build.
